chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sukūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Ṭūbā is for the poor who are patient, and they are those who behold the dominion of the heavens and the earth.”

key_terms.لِلْمَسَاكِينِ: for the poor and needy people
key_terms.مَلَكُوتَ: the inner dominion and unseen kingdom

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about poor believers who are patient?
ai.summary: This hadith praises the poor who endure with sabr, giving them glad tidings of great blessedness. It presents patient poverty not as deprivation alone, but as a station tied to spiritual insight into the malakut of the heavens and the earth.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Tooba is for the poor ones due to the patience, and they are those who would be shown the Kingdoms of the skies and the earth’.
en.sarwar: 13. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Holy Prophet has said, ‘Tuba (a tree in paradise) is for the destitutes who bear patience and they are the ones who observe the kingdom of heavens and earth.’”
